title: Rav Chanin (Rav’s Student)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites “Rav Chanin said that Rav said” in Yoma 41b, Nedarim 7b and Sotah 9b and 10a. In Meilah 17a: “Rav Chanin said that Rav Ze’ira said”; Hyman reports that Shitah Mekubbetzet deletes Ze’ira.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied tractate form is במילה. The William Davidson digital text of Meilah 17a explicitly has “Rav Chanin said that Rav Ze’ira said,” followed by the joining of impure creeping creatures and their blood. This matching named passage supports Meilah and supersedes the earlier unverified Moed Katan expansion. The earlier reviewer nonmatch reports for Moed Katan and Megillah remain preserved; they did not test Meilah. The saved Yoma 41b paragraph fully writes Rabbi Chanin, while Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav.

The complete named paragraphs have Rav Chanin reporting Rav in Nedarim 7b, but Rabbi Chanin reporting Rav in Yoma 41b and Sotah 9b and 10a. The Meilah 17a sequence has Rav Chanin reporting Rav Ze’ira. Hyman’s title and student classification remain his; the reported Shitah Mekubbetzet deletion was not freshly collated, and no teacher chronology or legal ruling is admitted.
